content: Surrounding-text client support is best-effort: ibus issue #2354 - delete surrounding text does not work in Chromium-based apps (browsers, Electron); ibus issue #2054 - Firefox dropped IBUS_CAP_SURROUNDING_TEXT after first typing (since fixed). IBUS_CAP_SURROUNDING_TEXT = 1<<5 delivered via SetCapabilities(u caps). GTK ibus IM modules support surrounding text. Architecture consequence: correction must track per-input-context caps and fall back to forwarding BackSpace key events when surrounding text unavailable/broken; commit_text works everywhere IBus works.
